data.name: Mrittika
data.gender_notes: Mrittika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who defies death. In Hindu mythology, Mrittika was the name of a divine nymph who, despite her name, was immune to death. The god of death, Yama, was infatuated with her and pursued her relentlessly. She managed to escape his grasp by wearing the leaves of the Tulsi plant, which made her invisible to him. The name Mrittika carries the meaning “Death-defying” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mrittika usually hope their child will grow to embody death-defying and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes courage and determination against adversity.
data.etymology: Mrittika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Death-defying.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mrittika total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
